single_change: Replace binary relative frontier-gain credit by scale-normalized positive frontier gain above a fixed empirical repeat-variation gate. Keep planner, writer parents, selection, trigger, probation, proposal order and CPU/case/evaluation budget fixed.
threshold_rule: Median across all20 frozen selected programs per task of absolute difference between the two public training rereads. Frozen before any new evolution. A heuristic sensitivity parameter, not a calibrated noise confidence bound.
gain_history: Prior finite positive global frontier gains from retained64-evaluation allocation history only. No future observations. Cold start credit1 above gate.
budget_constraint: Cumulative math cap74USD unchanged; about10USD conservatively available. No launch before integration tests and explicit paired protocol freeze.
caution: May suppress real gains or reward noisy ones; fractional Beta credits are heuristic. New runs remain development evidence and cannot establish statistical superiority from a small pilot.
